# Yucore Industrial Supply

> Yucore Industrial Supply is the industrial sourcing brand of Guangzhou Xiaoyu Import & Export Co., Ltd. The public site is in Russian and describes industrial equipment and MRO sourcing from China for buyers in Russia.

Website: https://yucore.ru/
Language: Russian
